Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total column (p5); business-type from the proprietary funds statement Total column (p7); business-type receipts total = total operating revenues + interest income (computed); business-type disbursements total 641,649 as printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating expenses 612,923 + interest 27,926 + bond issuance costs 800. ending_cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet cash and cash equivalents 1,268,215 (p4); certificates of deposit 261,164 in ending_investments; county treasurer cash 7,157 (p4) is a separate printed line not added. Beginning cash not printed for governmental funds. Government-wide loss on disposal of equipment (13,238, p3) is not in the fund statements. General Fund detail is taken from the departmental combining schedule (pp14-15, ties to the statement General column); the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p10, budget basis) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Street and LB840 budget schedules (pp11-12) recorded; nonmajor Lottery and CDBG from the combining statement (p13); No business-type detail lines (aligned with FY2024: funds with their own schedules only; Water/Sewer/Trash proprietary statement fund-column lines removed). Department functions follow the statement (Medical Clinic counted in General government; Cemetery counted in Public works, recorded as health/welfare with review). Component unit (CRA) excluded.
